title: Northgate Credit Cards Application Acceptance and Credit Decisions
content:
Northgate member services desk guidance on when an application for a Northgate Credit Cards product is taken, and on whose decision the credit is. A member applies at a club, online or through member services' referral to Meridian Trust Bank.

## Acceptance conditions

A card is applied for only while the membership it will be linked to has status active, and only for a product whose listed membership tiers include that membership's tier and whose required membership segment matches its segment. Business products also require the business's EIN where the product requires it and a personal guarantee where the product requires one.

Laid out condition by condition:

| # | Condition | What is looked at |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The membership the card will be linked to has status active | That membership's own record, read before the application is taken; the applicant's statement does not replace it |
| 2 | The membership's tier is one of the tiers the product lists | The membership's tier against the product's list of membership tiers |
| 3 | The membership's segment matches the product's required membership segment | Consumer against consumer, business against business |
| 4 | Where the product requires the business's EIN, it is provided | Business products whose terms require the EIN |
| 5 | Where the product requires a personal guarantee, the applicant gives it | Business products whose terms require it |

Each condition is required. If any one of them is not met, the card is not applied for.

### Status of the membership to be linked (condition 1)

| Status shown on the membership record | Card applied for under condition 1 |
|---|---|
| Active | Condition met |
| Expired, suspended, cancelled, closed or any other status | No |

## Credit decision and credit terms

The credit decision, the credit line (never below the product's smallest credit line), the APR and every other credit term are Meridian Trust Bank's. Northgate member services can neither approve, reconsider nor change them, and an applicant who disputes a decision is referred to the bank.

An application stays in status applied until the bank decides it:

- **Approved.** The account becomes active, the new card's last four digits are recorded and the bank's credit line is assigned. Where the product offers same-day use of the line on approval, the approved applicant may use the line in a club the same day.
- **Declined.** The account becomes declined, dated with the decision date.

## Points of judgement

- **A member asks member services to raise the credit line the bank assigned, or to approve an application the bank declined.** Neither is member services' to decide; the applicant who disputes the decision is referred to the bank.
- **A membership is suspended on the day of the application.** Condition 1 is not met, so the card is not applied for.
- **A business membership whose tier the product lists, status active, for a business product requiring an EIN and a personal guarantee, with both supplied.** Conditions 1 to 5 are met.
